description: Maillage Cyclable - Points-Noeuds (Tronçons) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département du Doubs. Le réseau cyclable par Point-Nœud repose sur un système de jalonnement et de numérotation des carrefours permettant de renvoyer les usagers vers d’autres intersections numérotées pour ainsi créer un itinéraire sur-mesure. Ce maillage est conçu pour offrir une liberté totale à tous les usagers. Coverage: Département du Doubs. The publisher named on the listing is Département du Doubs. Its keywords include route, cyclable, territoire, tourisme. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, JSON, ZIP. The listing shows 2026-07-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
